steps.title: Origins
steps.summary: Occupation in life plus apparent age; roll mortal occupation for inspiration.

steps.title: Turning
steps.summary: Who turned her and why; write progenitor and reason for turning.

steps.title: Innate Gifts
steps.summary: Three innate Gifts; blight follows the chosen innate-powers Truth (1492-1510).

steps.title: Skills and Assets
steps.summary: Three Aspects: main-talent Expertise, useful Expertise-or-Edge, survival Expertise-or-Edge.

steps.title: Magic
steps.summary: Optional: exchange innate Gifts for Mysteries one for one, up to 3.

steps.title: Relationships
steps.summary: Two Connections, one with mentor or progenitor; rank per 986-1008.

steps.title: Attributes
steps.summary: Distribute +3, +2, +2, +1 across Body, Mind, Charm, Soul.

steps.title: Identity
steps.summary: Looks and vibe, possessions, name, home; roll vampire home for inspiration.

steps.title: Finishing Touches
steps.summary: Max Rush 10, base Rush 2, current Rush 2; Health and Clarity 5; Blood 4.
